_comment: The three explicit route cards remain fail-closed and link-free until their own publication predicates pass. Separately, the five support-meaning cards in pages/vex-support.html reuse the exact Stripe Checkout URLs already preserved in pages/connect.html.
publicationRule: Never render an unverified routes[] destination as active. The five support-meaning Stripe links are a separate static projection restored from pages/connect.html after Victor reconfirmed them on 2026-10-23.

routes.note: A personal direct-transfer route is identified, but its receiving detail is deliberately absent: this repository must not guess, infer, or reconstruct it, and Victor's phone number is not published by default.
requiredBeforePublication: Confirm the intended personal receiving account
Complete a trusted small test transfer
Supply a public-safe QR asset or a dedicated enrolled email
Do not expose Victor's phone number by default

routes.note: GitHub Sponsors requires a completed public presence before approval, and approval carries its own review period. Once live it takes no platform cut, which is why the tier amounts below wait for it rather than being pointed at a processor that would take a percentage. candidateUrl is recorded for verification and is intentionally NOT the url field — nothing renders from candidateUrl.
requiredBeforePublication: Confirm the public profile resolves for a logged-out visitor
Confirm published tier amounts and welcome language

routes.note: Commercial engagements are a separate door from personal sponsorship. No support meaning promises any commercial deliverable, and this route must stay visually distinct from the two personal routes.
requiredBeforePublication: Victor selects the business inquiry destination
The page continues to distinguish engagement from sponsorship

tierAmounts.confirmedBy: Victor, 2026-10-23 — restore the Stripe links preserved on the earlier Connect page to the corresponding five support meanings.

legacyStripeLinks.reason: The five Stripe Checkout URLs preserved on the earlier Connect page are restored on pages/vex-support.html after Victor's 2026-10-23 reconfirmation. This does not activate the separate direct-transfer, GitHub Sponsors, or Vextreme LLC route cards.

capacityFigures.reason: Founder-reported amounts have not been reconciled against current lender statements, one figure was tied to a date that had already passed when it was supplied, and one total has ambiguous component scope that risks double-counting. The stage ladder on the page therefore carries state, not numbers.
